title: DOT-08: Public-candidate sufficiency matrix
publisher: U.S. Government Accountability Office and named implementing agency
summary: GAO-18-132 Recommendation 1 receives a public-candidate sufficiency matrix with an exact target, custodian, repository route, three directive-element decisions, stop rule, and reopening trigger.
key_findings: Target artifact: DOT Automated Vehicle Framework and related initiatives.
Likely custodian: DOT Office of the Secretary or the named operating administration.
Acquisition status: Public candidate matrix complete; authoritative sufficiency unresolved.

Directive element 1: One department-wide automated-vehicle plan — Partly supported by located public record. Locator: DOT April 2025 Automated Vehicle Framework release: three principles and initial initiatives, but not one department-wide comprehensive plan.

Directive element 2: Goals, priorities, and implementation steps — Partly supported by located public record. Locator: GAO-18-132 Recommendation 1: as of March 2026 DOT still lacks priorities, milestones, and other leading planning principles.

Directive element 3: Milestones and performance measures — Not established by located public record. Locator: No page or section in the release establishes a complete milestone and performance-measure system for departmental AV initiatives.
Stop rule: Stop FTFN sufficiency review at the page-and-section matrix; do not convert the matrix into GAO acceptance.
Reopening trigger: A new agency attachment, public exact-title match, successor directive, GAO page update, or named custodian release.
Next action: Monitor the GAO recommendation page for an explicit acceptance decision or named remaining deficiency; retain the public candidate and locator matrix meanwhile.
GAO acceptance state: GAO says artifact scope is incomplete.
why_it_matters: The queue turns a generic missing-or-adjacent evidence gap into a reproducible retrieval route or a bounded page-level sufficiency record without claiming authority FTFN does not have.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves DOT-08 and its exact recommendation identity.
Names the artifact, likely custodian, repositories, search terms, stop rule, and reopening trigger.
Separates source location and visible scope from GAO acceptance, implementation, closure, and operating outcomes.
evidence_limits: Not publicly acquired does not mean nonexistent, withheld, or never submitted.
A repository portal is a retrieval route, not the recommendation-specific implementation artifact.
FTFN's directive matrix does not substitute for GAO's recommendation-sufficiency or closure decision.
Document evidence does not establish performance, readiness, safety, savings, value, ranking, composite score, or causation.
